name: Cmd/Ctrl+Comma to open settings
description: Adds an openSettings action to the configurable hotkey system, bound by default to the macOS-standard Cmd+Comma (Ctrl+Comma elsewhere), and wires it up to open the settings dialog.

steps.title: Register the openSettings hotkey
steps.body: Adds `openSettings` to the configurable hotkey registry: the action tuple, a UI label/description, and the default binding. Because `mod` matches either Cmd or Ctrl at runtime, one default (`{ key: ",", mod: true }`) covers macOS and Windows/Linux. The Hotkeys settings tab iterates `HOTKEY_ACTIONS`, so this entry shows up there automatically and is rebindable.

callouts.body: The new default binding. `mod: true` is the platform-primary modifier, so this is Cmd+Comma on macOS and Ctrl+Comma elsewhere.

steps.title: Wire the shortcut to the settings dialog
steps.body: Registers a global keydown listener (mirroring the existing sidebar-toggle handler) that opens the settings dialog when the binding matches, and removes it in the effect cleanup.

steps.title: Changeset
steps.body: Patch changeset describing the user-facing addition.
